bounded_source_progress.detail: A bounded read of already owned data recovered 53 completed-game candidates and 159 winner/spread/total rows. Actual acquisition, official team aliases, exact ordered fixtures, paired prices and current analytical-display permission were checked. These are early snapshots, 22.1–97.6 hours before the requested cutoff. No candidate value is published or credited as a qualified model-versus-market baseline.
remaining_gates: Exact historical bookmaker jurisdiction, settlement rules and contract version are unbound.
The early snapshot does not establish a fresh T120 quote.
No overlap with the 47-game issued cohort; comparable information horizons remain unproved.

prior_execution.cpu_detail: Registered study: 45 worker PIDs, 36.011441 worker CPU seconds, 14.214176 wall seconds, 201 complete states reused. Short queue measurements do not prove sustained full capacity occupancy.
prior_execution.feature_progress: Current schedule context: 274 team rows, 172 eligible rows on 86 pending games; 2 eligible rows lack history. No feature ablation, new fit or measured improvement from this milestone. Play/drive input qualification remains separate.
prior_execution.summary: The current owner exited 0 and committed 2,236 genuine forecast records across 86 games. Physical receipt, event and matrix audits verify 26 new base estimators, 201 reused complete states and 8 new winner calibrators. The fixed chronological recipe changed the admitted training cohort from 9,150 to 9,152 rows; no identical-input base fit was repeated. Operational completion is not full scientific acceptance.
